soundtrack.engine: pipeline/score.py (original, procedural; no samples or third-party audio)
soundtrack.sections: A hook s01-s02 · B investigation s03-s05 · C questions s06-s09 · D cliffhanger s10-s11 (impact on 'trial' at 70.4 s) · E exit s12
soundtrack.licence: original work generated in this repository; no attribution required (see docs/CREDITS.md)

editorial_review.method: rendered artefact: 24 extracted frames + 12 re-render frames, measured audio (pipeline/audio_qa.py), offline ASR transcript; no human listening test was possible in this environment

findings.note: Hook lands: tow yard, smell, remains, then the registration card and D4VD caption by ~9 s.
Press-room shot near-static for 10 s (only card rows change).
Hills shot dark and static for 9 s; house partly under the timeline card in preview.
Restrained build: section phone-band medians A -41.9, B -45.4, C -43.5, D -40.9, E -41.8 dB; drops at 6 s and 51 s are intentional.
Cliffhanger impact lands on 'trial'; unresolved cluster carries into the exit.
Rain effect bed held at ~-32 dBFS and was chopped in the last 20 ms while the picture faded; the ending check (250 ms average) missed it.
First word at 0.31 s (intended 0.25), gap bed 14.5 dB under speech, no holes; -14.2 LUFS, TP -1.6 dBTP, mono 0 LU.
Defence quote card should say the lawyers were former counsel (they withdrew 31 Aug 2026).
All narration attributed and sourced (13 claims, >=2 sources each); 'pleaded not guilty', 'not a verdict', 'presumed innocent' present; next date 19 Oct as scheduled 31 Aug, re-searched 2026-10-11.
Two longest shots back to back at the midpoint with little motion: drop-off risk.
Charge card text 26-29 px is small on a phone.

fixes_applied: master tail fade in pipeline/mixdown.py (all score and effects end with the picture) + stricter ending check (last 50 ms < -48 dBFS) + regression test
press room: keyed push-in wide -> medium -> close, handheld; podium extended to the floor
hills: stronger push toward the house, handheld; house moved clear of the timeline card
Case Files 01/02 re-mixed with the same fix and re-verified

executive_producer.note: Mid-video shots now move (push-ins); every scene adds a new fact; ending lands on the next hearing and the presumption of innocence.

composer_sound_designer.note: Score sections and drops unchanged; exit fades with the picture. Remaining: the build is deliberately restrained; louder D section is a taste call, not changed.

audio_engineer.note: Last 50 ms -95.5 dBFS, last 250 ms -66.2 dBFS; all 10 audio checks pass; full decode clean; A/V within 58 ms.

legal_factual.note: Former-counsel attribution added; no allegation presented as fact; no graphic or tabloid detail; no real person depicted.

mobile_retention.note: Captions inside the safe area (x 105-975, y 1281-1483); cards readable; first 10 s strong.

outstanding: No human listening test was possible here; levels are measured, not heard.
The 19 Oct 2026 hearing could be continued after publication; re-check the docket before posting and update the closing line if it moves.
